messages:
Ava: Quick preflight — Thursday's virtual session: need a short checklist for registration page copy, Zoom recording settings (we need separate files + SRT), and post-event clip routing. Who can own each?
Sam: I can own Zoom recorder config + Zap. Will set cloud recording -> separate files, enable auto-transcribe.
Emma: On registration copy — keep CTA two lines: 1) what they'll learn (benchmark + cost tips) 2) CTA (Join live & request a 1:1). Also add accessibility note: live captions available.
Priya: For post-event follow-up: 24h replay email, 72h highlights clips, and a nurture email 7 days with CTA to trial. Short subject lines: "Replay + Top 3 Takeaways".
Micha: Routing: suggestions — transcripts -> S3, clips -> Airtable record per speaker, marketing tags for MQL scoring. Zapier or our clip microservice? ops-bot: Suggest clip microservice webhook to avoid Zap limit.
Sam: Zap flow (sketch): 
```
Trigger: Zoom "Cloud Recording Completed"
Action: Formatter extract file URLs
Action: Upload files -> S3 bucket: marketing/events/{event_id}/raw/
Action: Webhook POST -> https://clips.internal/api/submit with body {"s3_path": "...", "event": "mini-bench-04-2026"}
```
Emma: Zoom settings I'm toggling in the meeting: Record separate files for each participant, Record active speaker, Cloud recording, Auto-transcribe (SRT). Also set co-host for recording start/stop.
Ava: Priya + Emma please draft the 2-line reg page copy and the 24h email. Sam — can you post the Zap webhook URL and an example payload? Micha — can you confirm Airtable schema for clip ownership?
Priya: Draft reg copy: "See how teams cut 2x token cost in production. Live demo + post-event clips. Captions provided." CTA: "Save my seat". Sending 2 variants in thread.
Sam: Example webhook payload (will post test endpoint): 
```
POST /api/submit
{
  "event": "mini-bench-04-2026",
  "s3_raw": "s3://marketing/events/mini-bench-04-2026/raw/rec-123.mp4",
  "transcript_srt": "s3://marketing/events/mini-bench-04-2026/raw/rec-123.srt",
  "requested_clips": ["talk1", "qna"]
}
```
Micha: Airtable: fields = EventID, ClipID, Speaker, TimestampStart, TimestampEnd, Status, Owner, Tags. I'll create the base and share.
Emma: Accessibility small note for regpage: "Live captions available. Post-event transcripts provided in accessible formats (PDF, SRT)."
Ava: Perfect. Owners: Sam (Zoom + webhook), Emma (reg copy + a11y), Priya (emails), Micha (Airtable + clip routing). I'll consolidate and push the runbook to the shared drive after Sam confirms the test endpoint. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Scheduled task created: event-runbook-mini-bench-04-2026 assigned to [Sam, Emma, Priya, Micha], due 2026-04-16.
Sam: Test endpoint: https://staging-clips.internal/api/submit — I'll drop results here after first test upload.
Priya: Variant A for reg page: "Cut inference cost in production—live demo + takeaways. Captions provided. Save my seat." Variant B: "Benchmark your latency & cost—join a short workshop. Replay & transcripts after." Which do we prefer?
Micha: Lean B for developer audience, A for ops/finance. We can A/B by utm=audience param.
Ava: Great call. Let's A/B. Everyone: please react when your task is done so I can mark the runbook complete.
Emma: On it — updating page copy now.
Sam: Running first webhook test in ~10m.
Priya: Draft 24h replay email in docs -> sharing link: https://docs.redwood/inbox/mini-bench-04-2026/replay-draft
Micha: Airtable base link shared in thread DM.
Ava: Thanks all — short check on Thursday standup.
